main_results.name: IsBaseChange.toDualBaseChangeOfProjective
main_results.note: Canonical dual base change for finite projective modules over commutative semirings.

main_results.name: IsBaseChange.contractBaseChangeEquivOfProjective
main_results.note: Evaluation/contraction compatibility for finite projectives over commutative rings.

main_results.name: ExteriorAlgebra.equivBaseChange
main_results.note: Full exterior-algebra base change over arbitrary commutative rings and modules; no finite, projective, flat or invertible-two assumption. This is not a fixed-degree scalar-extension equivalence.

main_results.name: exteriorPower.prodEquivDirectSum
main_results.note: Every-degree binary Sum Formula for arbitrary modules over a commutative ring, with ordered P-before-Q wedge inverse and degree zero included.

main_results.name: exteriorPower.prodEquivDirectSum_naturality
main_results.note: Naturality for arbitrary linear maps over a fixed commutative base ring.

main_results.name: exteriorPower.instProjective
main_results.note: Exterior powers preserve projectivity, without finite-generation assumptions.

main_results.name: exteriorPower.determinant
main_results.note: Scalar determinant construction assuming the chosen exterior power is invertible.

main_results.name: Module.Basis.exteriorPower_determinant_eq_det
main_results.note: Finite-basis top-exterior action agrees with the determinant, including rank zero.

main_results.name: Module.invertible_iff_finite_projective_rankAtStalk_eq_one
main_results.note: Invertibility iff finite projectivity and stalk rank one, with these properties on the right as propositions, not preinstalled hypotheses. The zero ring and empty spectrum are not excluded.

main_results.name: Module.Invertible.toModuleEndRingEquiv
main_results.note: Every endomorphism of an invertible module is uniquely scalar.

main_results.name: Module.Invertible.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_fin_stabilization
main_results.note: Finite-free stabilization cancellation between invertible modules only.

main_results.name: Module.Invertible.isModuleTopology
main_results.note: The given topology of a Hausdorff invertible topological vector space over a nontrivially normed field is its module topology. Scalar and carrier universes are independent; neither field completeness nor a norm on the vector space is assumed.

main_results.name: ContinuousLinearMap.scalarEndEquiv
main_results.note: Scalar multiplication is a continuous linear equivalence from a nontrivially normed field to the bounded-convergence continuous endomorphisms of a Hausdorff invertible topological vector space. The original topology and independent scalar/carrier universes are retained, with no completeness, norm, input vector, frame or inverse. Forward action, inverse action on every vector, algebraic comparison and agreement with the scalar-field homothety equivalence are provided.

main_results.name: Module.Free.countableFinsuppEquivOfProdFiniteFinsuppEquiv
main_results.note: Cancel a finite free summand in countably infinite free coordinates; not arbitrary cancellation.

main_results.name: Module.Free.prodNatFinsuppEquivOfSplit
main_results.note: Countable free absorption of a module given explicit split maps.

main_results.name: Module.Free.rightIdealProdEndNatFinsuppEquiv
main_results.note: Corresponding absorption for complemented right ideals of a countable free endomorphism ring.

main_results.name: RingHom.rankCondition
main_results.note: Rank condition descends along any unital semiring homomorphism from a target with rank condition, with independent source and target universes; the map need not be injective or surjective.

main_results.name: RingHom.invariantBasisNumber
main_results.note: Invariant basis number descends along any unital semiring homomorphism from a target with invariant basis number; no rank-condition or injectivity premise is needed.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.linearIndependent_freeMonoid_of
main_results.note: The letter monomials form a linearly independent family over the left regular module of A = MonoidAlgebra K (FreeMonoid alphabet), for arbitrary Semiring K and independently universed alphabet. Canonical finitely supported linear combinations multiply each polynomial coordinate by its letter on the right; its terminal-word coefficients recover the coordinate. Injective reindexing gives arbitrary independent subfamilies. No Nontrivial, commutativity, centrality or finite-alphabet hypothesis. Trivial coefficients and the empty family are included without implying a nonzero module; repeated letters over nontrivial coefficients need not be independent. This is A-linear independence, not merely K-linearity.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeWordPairMap_eq_linearCombination
main_results.note: The two-letter left-A-linear map equals the canonical finitely supported linear combination after the inverse finite coordinate equivalence. Its distinct-letter injectivity follows by reindexing the general family.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeWordPairMap_injective
main_results.note: Over any Semiring K and any alphabet in an independent universe, distinct letters give an injective left-A-linear map from Fin 2 coordinates to A = MonoidAlgebra K (FreeMonoid alphabet). Right multiplication appends letters, and disjoint final suffixes recover both input coefficients. No Nontrivial, commutativity or finite-alphabet hypothesis; trivial coefficients give singleton modules.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.not_strongRankCondition_freeMonoid
main_results.note: For distinct letters over arbitrary semiring coefficients, the free-word semiring fails the strong rank condition: transport the pair injection to a Fin 1 codomain and contradict the strong-rank bound 2 ≤ 1. Mathlib's free-algebra contrast is credited there to T. Y. Lam. In the rational-Boolean case, rank condition and invariant basis number follow separately by augmentation; these positive properties are not asserted for every coefficient semiring. This entry asserts neither source correspondence nor whole-book coverage.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeMonoidAugmentation
main_results.note: Zero-generator ring homomorphism from the free-word semiring to its coefficient semiring. Coefficients may be noncommutative or trivial, and coefficient and alphabet universes are independent. Empty alphabets are allowed; no module action on the coefficient carrier is chosen by this construction.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeMonoidAugmentation_single
main_results.note: A monomial maps to its coefficient multiplied by the value of its word under the zero-generator word map.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeMonoidAugmentation_single_one
main_results.note: Constant monomials map to their coefficients.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeMonoidAugmentation_single_of
main_results.note: Every letter monomial maps to zero, for any coefficient.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.freeMonoidAugmentation_apply
main_results.note: The zero-generator augmentation returns x.coeff 1, the coefficient of the empty word, for every free-word polynomial over any semiring. Noncommutative and trivial coefficients and empty or infinite alphabets are included, with independent coefficient and alphabet universes.

main_results.name: MonoidAlgebra.range_linearCombination_freeMonoid_of_eq_ker_freeMonoidAugmentation
main_results.note: The range of Finsupp.linearCombination A of all letter monomials equals LinearMap.ker of the zero-generator augmentation's toSemilinearMap, with A = MonoidAlgebra K (FreeMonoid alphabet). Coordinates are A-valued and letters multiply on the right under the canonical left regular A-action. Only Semiring K is required; coefficient and alphabet universes are independent, including noncommutative or trivial coefficients and empty or infinite alphabets. No global Module A K instance, basis or linear equivalence onto the kernel is constructed.

main_results.name: Module.exists_fin_prod_linearEquiv_iff_finite_isStablyFree
main_results.note: Over arbitrary rings, existence of a finite-coordinate stable presentation is equivalent to finite generation and stable freeness, without IBN or a nontriviality assumption.

main_results.name: Module.card_add_card_eq_of_prod_linearEquiv
main_results.note: IBN-only cross-sum equality for any two finite-index presentations over semirings, with independent index universes and no freeness premise on the presented module.

main_results.name: Module.int_card_sub_eq_of_prod_linearEquiv
main_results.note: The associated integer coordinate differences agree without a rank condition, nonnegativity or natural subtraction.

main_results.name: Module.IsStablyFree.ker_of_surjective
main_results.note: Over an arbitrary ring, a surjection from a stably-free module onto a finitely generated stably-free module has stably-free kernel. No finite generation of the domain is assumed or of the kernel is concluded.

main_results.name: Module.finite_isStablyFree_iff_exists_fin_surjective_ker_equiv
main_results.note: Over an arbitrary ring, a module is finitely generated and stably free iff it is linearly equivalent to the kernel of a surjection between Fin n and Fin m coordinate modules for some natural m and n. This asserts neither a rank inequality nor an ordinary finite-presentation equivalence.

main_results.name: Matrix.finite_isStablyFree_ker_mulVecBilin_of_surjective
main_results.note: For independently universe-polymorphic finite row and column index types over any ring, a surjective Matrix.mulVecBilin R Rᵐᵒᵖ A has finitely generated stably-free right-module kernel. Entries multiply coordinates on the left as A i j * x j. Empty index types and zero rings are included where surjectivity holds; no IBN, commutativity or free-kernel claim.

main_results.name: mk_eq_mk_of_basis_of_infinite
main_results.note: Equal lifted index cardinalities for two bases of the same module, when the first index is infinite over a nontrivial semiring; no IBN, SRC or commutativity.

main_results.name: Module.Basis.indexEquivOfInfinite
main_results.note: A choice of index equivalence for these bases; it need not carry one basis vector to another.

main_results.name: Module.Basis.indexEquivOfInfinite_eq_indexEquiv
main_results.note: Under IBN, the chosen index equivalence agrees with Basis.indexEquiv.

main_results.name: Finsupp.nonempty_linearEquiv_iff_equiv
main_results.note: With an infinite first index, free coordinate modules are linearly equivalent iff their index types are equivalent, including across index universes.

main_results.name: Finsupp.nonempty_linearEquiv_iff_lift_mk_eq
main_results.note: Equivalent lifted-cardinality criterion for free coordinates in distinct index universes.

main_results.name: Finsupp.not_nonempty_linearEquiv_of_infinite_finite
main_results.note: No linear equivalence from infinite to finite free coordinates over a nontrivial semiring.

main_results.name: Module.free_of_finite_isStablyFree_of_isSemisimpleRing
main_results.note: Finite stably-free modules over arbitrary semisimple rings are free; not all semisimple modules.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective
main_results.note: Finite projective modules as a full additive subcategory with finite biproducts over arbitrary rings.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.finite_iff_of_equivalence
main_results.note: A given ModuleCat.{vR} R ≌ ModuleCat.{vS} S preserves and reflects Module.Finite over arbitrary rings, with independent scalar universes uR, uS and carrier universes vR, vS.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.isFiniteProjective_of_equivalence
main_results.note: A given ModuleCat.{vR} R ≌ ModuleCat.{max uS vS} S sends the canonical finite-projective object property to itself. The source carrier is unrestricted; Small is not a public premise.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.isFiniteProjective_iff_of_equivalence
main_results.note: A given ModuleCat.{max uR vR} R ≌ ModuleCat.{max uS vS} S preserves and reflects the canonical finite-projective object property, with no linearity, commutativity or freeness assumption.

main_results.name: OrderIso.isCompactElement
main_results.note: Order isomorphisms map compact elements to compact elements in arbitrary partial orders.

main_results.name: OrderIso.isCompactElement_iff
main_results.note: Compact-element preservation and reflection at independent universes, without completeness or a top element.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.finiteProjectiveEssentiallySmall
main_results.note: For an arbitrary Ring R : Type u and independent carrier universe v, ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.{u,v} R is EssentiallySmall.{u}, derived from the finitely generated module category without an assumed Small premise. A smaller carrier universe need not represent every finite projective isomorphism class.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.repr
main_results.note: Bundle Module.Finite.repr R P as a finite projective object with carrier in the ring universe, for any finitely generated projective module P in an independent universe over an arbitrary ring.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.reprEquiv
main_results.note: The ring-universe representative is linearly equivalent to the original finite projective module by Mathlib's Module.Finite.reprEquiv; no carrier or scalar Small hypothesis is assumed.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.isoClass
main_results.note: Send arbitrary finite projective inputs to the existing skeleton of ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.{u,u} R after taking a ring-universe representative. Applying this to Rᵐᵒᵖ gives right-module classes. This is not a K₀ group or a group-completion construction.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.isoClass_eq_iff
main_results.note: Equality of classes in the same ring-universe reference skeleton is equivalent to Nonempty (P ≃ₗ[R] Q) for finite projective inputs whose carrier universes may differ, with no commutativity or nontriviality assumption on R.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass
main_results.note: Ring-universe additive commutative monoid of direct-sum isomorphism classes of finite projective right modules over an arbitrary ring, using the complete ring-universe reference category. Module generators accept arbitrary independent carrier universes without a Small premise.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.of_eq_iff
main_results.note: Equality of module classes is exactly nonempty linear equivalence, including inputs in independent universes. Zero, product, representative and carrier-lift equations give the characteristic generator API.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.lift
main_results.note: Isomorphism-invariant object functions preserving zero and binary direct sums descend to additive maps into any AddZero target, with reference/module evaluation, extensionality and uniqueness laws.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0
main_results.note: Mathlib's additive Grothendieck group of the projective class monoid, in the ring universe, for arbitrary rings including the zero ring. For arbitrary rings, generator equality means common stabilization, not necessarily module isomorphism.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.lift
main_results.note: Additive class maps to any additive commutative group extend uniquely to K₀ homomorphisms. Restriction is inverse to extension, and module generator evaluation and homomorphism extensionality are provided.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.map
main_results.note: Scalar extension along an arbitrary unital ring homomorphism induces an additive map on finite-projective right-module classes. Evaluation accepts independent carrier universes; identity and composition agree as whole homomorphisms, including noncommutative and zero rings.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.map
main_results.note: The induced K₀ map extends the class map through group completion, agrees on every class and arbitrary-carrier module generator, and respects identity and composition as whole homomorphisms. This general-ring scalar-extension API alone asserts no injectivity, dimension classification or cancellation of projective modules.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.map_eq_map
main_results.note: Any two unital homomorphisms from a fixed division ring to a fixed ring induce equal whole additive class maps. A finite source basis compares both extensions with the same target coordinate module; the target may be noncommutative or a zero ring, without a target dimension invariant.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.map_eq_map
main_results.note: The whole K₀ homomorphisms induced by two maps from a division ring to an arbitrary ring agree, by the class equality and group-completion extensionality. No injectivity of the class-to-K₀ map is assumed.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.exists_sub
main_results.note: Every K₀ element is a difference of two finite projective right-module generators in the complete ring-universe reference category. The chosen representative pair has a reconstruction law, not uniqueness or additivity.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.of_eq_iff_exists_projective_stabilizer
main_results.note: Two finite projective generators agree exactly when their modules become linearly equivalent after adjoining one common finite projective module in the ring universe. No module cancellation or nonzero-ring premise.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.of_eq_iff_exists_free_stabilizer
main_results.note: Generator equality is equivalent to linear equivalence after adjoining the same Fin n → Rᵐᵒᵖ. The rank n is existential, without IBN or a prescribed rank; input carrier universes may differ.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.sub_eq_sub_iff_exists_projective_stabilizer
main_results.note: Equality [P] - [Q] = [P'] - [Q'] is equivalent to linear equivalence of the cross-sums P × Q' and P' × Q after one common finite projective stabilizer. All four input carrier universes are independent.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.sub_eq_sub_iff_exists_free_stabilizer
main_results.note: The same difference equality is equivalent to stabilization of its cross-sums by one common standard finite free module. Cancellation is in the abelian group only, not among projective modules.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.finrankHom
main_results.note: Finite dimension descends to a natural-valued additive class map over a division ring. Evaluation requires finite generation, with freeness and projectivity supplied by division-ring scalars. This is the whole forward homomorphism of ProjectiveClass.finrankEquiv.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.finrankEquiv
main_results.note: For DivisionRing D, an AddEquiv ProjectiveClass D ≃+ ℕ whose forward homomorphism is the canonical finrankHom. Its inverse sends every n to the class of Fin n → Dᵐᵒᵖ. Both canonical-map round trips, arbitrary-carrier finite-module evaluation and dimension recovery, and regular-class one and inverse-one laws are provided.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.finrankHom
main_results.note: Integer-valued K₀ dimension uniquely extends natural class dimension, evaluates on finitely generated modules in arbitrary carrier universes, and sends the regular generator to one. This is the whole forward homomorphism of K0.finrankEquiv.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.finrankEquiv
main_results.note: For DivisionRing D, an AddEquiv K0 D ≃+ ℤ whose forward homomorphism is the canonical finrankHom. Its inverse sends every integer z, including negatives, to z • K0.of D Dᵐᵒᵖ; natural casts recover finite-coordinate generators. Both canonical-map round trips, arbitrary-carrier finite-module evaluation and dimension recovery, regular-generator one and inverse-one laws, and class-completion compatibility are provided. Equality of finite-module generators is equivalent to right-linear isomorphism over division rings only.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.finrankHom_comp_map
main_results.note: Scalar extension along any unital φ : D →+* S between division rings preserves natural class dimension as an equality of whole canonical additive homomorphisms, with independent scalar universes.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.finrankHom_comp_map
main_results.note: The induced K₀ scalar-extension map along the same arbitrary unital division-ring homomorphism preserves integer dimension as an equality of whole canonical homomorphisms, by group completion.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.map_bijective
main_results.note: Scalar extension along any unital homomorphism between division rings induces a bijective additive class map, using the canonical natural dimension equivalences and their whole-map compatibility. The scalar homomorphism need not be surjective; its universes are independent.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.map_bijective
main_results.note: The induced K₀ map between division rings is bijective, using the canonical integer dimension equivalences and naturality. This concerns all group elements, including negative regular-generator multiples, not only the positive class generators.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.subsingleton_of_subsingleton
main_results.note: The entire K₀ group of a subsingleton ring is a subsingleton, as is the direct-sum class monoid. Generator normalization does not use the nonadditive zero-ring convention for module finrank.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.Stable.quotient_map_eq_iff
main_results.note: Stable equality is factorization of the difference through a projective; the quotient is preadditive.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FactorsThroughProjective.iff_ext_one_precomp_eq_zero
main_results.note: Detect projective factorization by all Ext-one precomposition maps; retains the Small.{uM} R universe hypothesis. No abelian stable-category structure, completed-group-ring duality or transpose theory is asserted.

main_results.name: BalancedTensorProduct.lift
main_results.note: Universal additive balanced map for a right and a left module over an arbitrary ring.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.balancedTensor_short_exact
main_results.note: Tensoring a left-module short exact pair with a fixed projective right module preserves exactness.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.hom_short_exact
main_results.note: Additive Hom exactness for a projective source over an arbitrary semiring.

main_results.name: Module.piRightModule
main_results.note: Named coordinatewise opposite-scalar action on a family of semimodules over a family of semirings. Index, coefficient and carrier universes are independent; the family need not be finite. No global action instance or unital coordinate-inclusion homomorphism is introduced.

main_results.name: Module.projective_piRight
main_results.note: For a finite index, coefficient-product assembly preserves arbitrary projectivity over semirings, without finite-generation assumptions. Independently sized binary semiring factors have the corresponding projective closure theorem.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.pi
main_results.note: Canonical coefficient-product bundle of a finite family of finite-projective right modules over arbitrary rings. Finite generation and projectivity of the output are proved, with carrier, coordinate, action, extensionality and finite reconstruction APIs.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.prodRight
main_results.note: Binary finite-projective coefficient-product assembly with separately quantified scalar and carrier universes. Zero module factors and zero coefficient rings are not excluded.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.piRecoverLinearEquiv
main_results.note: Extension of an assembled right-module family along a coordinate projection recovers that factor, with forward and inverse pure-tensor formulas. The index need not be finite; no finite-generation or projectivity premise is required.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.piLinearEquiv
main_results.note: An arbitrary right module over a finite product of arbitrary rings is linearly equivalent to the product of its coordinate projection extensions. Both directions use the balanced tensor construction and supported coordinate idempotents; scalar, index and carrier universes are independent, including empty families and zero rings.

main_results.name: Module.piRightHomAddEquiv
main_results.note: For an arbitrary index and a family of possibly noncommutative semirings, maps linear for the canonical piRightModule coefficient-product action on right-module families with additive commutative monoid fibers correspond additively to families of factor-linear maps. The component at i sends m to f (Pi.single i m) i; the inverse acts coordinatewise. Component evaluation, supported inputs, equality detection, identity and composition laws retain independent index, coefficient, source, target and third-family universes. This is an additive equivalence, with no finiteness, finite-generation, projectivity, presentation or commutativity hypotheses; it is separate from reconstruction of arbitrary modules over finite products of rings by projection scalar extension.

main_results.name: Module.piRightEndEquiv
main_results.note: Semiring equivalence between endomorphisms of the canonical assembled right module and the family of factor endomorphism semirings, using precisely the additive data of piRightHomAddEquiv. Components evaluate on supported inputs and the inverse acts coordinatewise; identities and multiplication are preserved in the order f * g = f.comp g. The index is arbitrary, semiring coefficients need not commute, and fibers need only be additive commutative monoids with their right module structures. Index, coefficient and carrier universes are independent; no finite-generation, projectivity or presentation assumption is imposed.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.piEquiv
main_results.note: Additive monoid equivalence from finite-projective classes over a finite coefficient product of arbitrary rings to the family of factor classes, with the existing projection scalar-extension maps as its forward homomorphism. The inverse assembles canonical coefficient-product modules; whole-hom, coordinate, module-generator and equality-detection laws include empty families and zero rings.

main_results.name: KTheory.ProjectiveClass.prodEquiv
main_results.note: Binary projective-class additive equivalence along the two projection scalar extensions, with separately quantified scalar and module carrier universes. Factors need not be commutative or nontrivial; no cancellation of classes is required.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.piEquiv
main_results.note: Additive group equivalence between K0 of a finite product of arbitrary rings and the family of factor K0 groups. Forward whole-hom and coordinate formulas agree with projection scalar extension; inverse module-generator, group-completion and signed-presentation formulas compute general differences of finite-projective classes, without assuming injectivity of the class-to-K0 map.

main_results.name: KTheory.K0.prodEquiv
main_results.note: Binary K0 additive equivalence with independent scalar and carrier universes, inverse generator and signed formulas, and coordinate equality detection. Zero rings and noncommutative factors are included; signed classes do not require cancellation.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.adjunction
main_results.note: Right-module scalar extension/restriction adjunction for arbitrary ring maps, with finite/projective preservation.

main_results.name: IsIdempotentElem.rightSpanFiniteProjective
main_results.note: Bundle the principal right ideal of an idempotent over an arbitrary ring as a finite projective right module.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.spanFiniteProjective
main_results.note: Bundle scalar extension of an idempotent right ideal as a finite projective right module over arbitrary source and target rings.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.spanLinearEquivOfMapEqOne
main_results.note: Along an arbitrary ring map from R to S, the principal right ideal generated by op e extends to the regular right S-module when f e = 1. No idempotence, centrality of the generator or whole homomorphism image, commutativity or nontriviality hypothesis is imposed. The image of e itself is necessarily central. Forward evaluation is m tensor s mapped to op (f (unop m) * s), with the inverse given by the tensor of e with the target scalar.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.span_subsingleton_of_map_eq_zero
main_results.note: Over arbitrary source and target rings, extension of the right ideal generated by an idempotent e is a subsingleton when f e = 0, including the zero-ring cases. The proof uses idempotent action only on the generator, then principal generation and balancing; the idempotent need not fix every member of the source ideal.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tmulOne_surjective
main_results.note: The canonical scalar-extension map is surjective when the coefficient homomorphism is surjective.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.idealQuotientLinearEquiv
main_results.note: Scalar extension along a two-sided ideal quotient agrees with the right-module ideal-action quotient.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.finrank_idealQuotient_prod_of_isMaximal
main_results.note: Residue dimensions add for finite modules, retaining two-sided/maximal and division-quotient hypotheses.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.rightFreeLinearEquiv
main_results.note: Explicit scalar extension of finite standard right-free modules, including empty coordinates.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.innerLinearEquiv
main_results.note: For arbitrary rings R and S, homomorphisms φ ψ : R →+* S, and a unit u with u * φ r = ψ r * u for every r, the two extensions of any right R-module are right-S-linearly equivalent. A pure tensor m ⊗_φ s maps to m ⊗_ψ (u * s), with inverse coefficient u⁻¹ * s; the right target action is unchanged. Scalar and carrier universes are independent, without commutativity, finite generation, projectivity or centrality assumptions.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.innerLinearEquiv_toLinearMap_eq_iff
main_results.note: One-generator values characterize the entire right-linear comparison. The characteristic API also gives both ordered tensor formulas, source balancing, fixed right scalar action, the whole inverse equivalence and the identity for the unit 1.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.idLinearEquiv
main_results.note: Identity extension of an arbitrary right module over a ring is linearly equivalent to the original module: m ⊗ r maps to op r • m and the inverse sends m to m ⊗ 1. Scalar and module universes are independent; no finite-generation, projectivity or nontriviality premise is needed.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.compLinearEquiv
main_results.note: For arbitrary ring homomorphisms φ : R →+* S and ψ : S →+* T, iterated right extension is linearly equivalent to extension along ψ.comp φ. The pure-tensor formula is (m ⊗ s) ⊗ t ↦ m ⊗ (ψ s * t), with inverse m ⊗ t ↦ (m ⊗ 1) ⊗ t, preserving multiplication order. Scalar and module universes are independent; no commutativity, injectivity, surjectivity, finiteness or projectivity is assumed.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.compLinearEquiv_id_left
main_results.note: Composition comparison with an identity first equals scalar extension of the identity comparison as a linear map. Both send (m ⊗ r) ⊗ s to m ⊗ (φ r * s), for arbitrary rings and right modules with independent scalar and module universes. This is a simp law.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.compLinearEquiv_id_right
main_results.note: Composition comparison with an identity last equals the identity comparison on the extended module as a linear equivalence. Both evaluate z ⊗ s by the right S-action on z, over arbitrary rings and right modules with independent scalar and module universes. This is a simp law.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.compLinearEquiv_assoc
main_results.note: Comparing the first two extensions and then the third equals comparing the last two and then the first, as linear maps. For arbitrary rings R, S, T, U, ring homomorphisms φ, ψ, θ and a module with only an AddCommGroup and a Module Rᵐᵒᵖ action, all five universes are independent. The pure-tensor identity is θ (ψ s * t) * u = θ (ψ s) * (θ t * u). No commutativity, injectivity, surjectivity, freeness, finiteness or projectivity is required, and no categorical coherence is asserted.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tensorProductObj_smul_tmul
main_results.note: Right target scalars act on the module-first tensor by coefficient right multiplication s * t, for a commutative base and arbitrary ring target; no central image is assumed.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tensorProductLinearEquiv
main_results.note: For CommRing R, Ring S and any right R-module in an independent universe, right extension along a unital φ agrees with the module-first Mathlib tensor using the canonical restricted source and coefficient actions.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tensorProductLinearEquiv_tmul
main_results.note: The module-first comparison sends the balanced pure tensor m tensor s to tensorProductTmul φ M m s with the specified coefficient action.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tensorProductLinearEquiv_symm_tmul
main_results.note: The inverse module-first comparison sends that Mathlib pure tensor to the corresponding balanced pure tensor.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tensorProductLinearEquiv_naturality
main_results.note: For a morphism of right modules in a common carrier universe, the comparison intertwines extension of the source map with its restricted tensor map and the identity of the specified coefficient module.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.tensorProductLinearEquiv_functor'_map
main_results.note: The same module-first intertwining law uses the right-extension functor' map, with independent source and output carrier universes.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.extendScalarsLinearEquiv
main_results.note: For CommRing R and CommRing S, right extension agrees pointwise with the right-module view of Mathlib's scalar-first ModuleCat.extendScalars φ; the output carrier is in max uM uS.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.extendScalarsLinearEquiv_tmul
main_results.note: The scalar-first comparison sends m tensor s to s tensor m using the canonical homomorphism-induced coefficient module and opposite source view.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.extendScalarsLinearEquiv_symm_tmul
main_results.note: The inverse scalar-first comparison sends s tensor m to the corresponding module-first balanced pure tensor.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.extendScalarsLinearEquiv_eq_comm
main_results.note: On carriers, the scalar-first comparison is TensorProduct.comm after the module-first comparison for the same specified module structures.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.RightExtension.extendScalarsLinearEquiv_naturality
main_results.note: Pointwise scalar-first naturality intertwines right extension of a module morphism with the maps of Mathlib's extension and both opposite scalar restriction functors.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension
main_results.note: Transport a supplied right-linear map from ι → R to κ → R along any unital homomorphism R →+* S of semirings. Only the source requires a Fintype instance; the target is arbitrary. Scalar and index universes are independent. Empty indices and zero semirings are not excluded. No commutativity, injectivity, surjectivity, IBN or equal index cardinalities are assumed. The noncomputable constructor needs no caller DecidableEq instance. Laws cover zero, addition, identities, coefficient images and coefficient-homomorphism composition.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeScalarExtensionEquiv
main_results.note: Under the same semiring and homomorphism hypotheses, transport a supplied right-linear equivalence and its inverse, with Fintype instances on both indices in independent universes. This does not assert that unequal finite ranks admit an equivalence. Laws give compatibility with the underlying transported map, inverse, equivalence composition, identity and coefficient-homomorphism identity and composition, without caller DecidableEq instances.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension_apply
main_results.note: For a finite source and arbitrary target, the i-th coordinate on y is ∑ j, f (g (Pi.single j 1) i) * y j. Coefficients multiply on the left; opposite-semiring module scalars act on the right. The single-vector and entrywise opposite-coordinate row-matrix laws characterize the same transport.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension_map_comp
main_results.note: Transport respects composition when the source and intermediate coordinate types have Fintype instances; the final target is arbitrary. All three index universes remain independent.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeScalarExtensionEquiv_apply
main_results.note: For a supplied equivalence with both coordinate types finite, the i-th coordinate on y is ∑ j, f (e (Pi.single j 1) i) * y j, agreeing with transport of its underlying right-linear map.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension_eq_rightExtension_of_decidableEq
main_results.note: Over rings with both indices finite, identify coefficient transport with the unbundled ModuleCat.RightExtension.map conjugated by the finite right-free coordinate equivalences. This variant uses the caller's DecidableEq instances on both indices; the corresponding rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension_eq_rightExtension law chooses them internally. These are data-compatibility bridges, not extra mathematical premises of the semiring constructor.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension_tmul_of_decidableEq
main_results.note: Over rings with both indices finite and caller DecidableEq instances, compatibility on pure tensors sends the coordinates of x ⊗ s to those of g x ⊗ s. The rightFreeLinearMapScalarExtension_tmul law chooses equality decisions internally. No infinite-product tensor equivalence is asserted by arbitrary-target map transport.

main_results.name: Module.rightFreeScalarExtensionEquiv_toLinearMap_eq_rightExtension_of_decidableEq
main_results.note: Over rings with both indices finite, the underlying map of a supplied transported equivalence agrees with the unbundled tensor map in finite right-free coordinates, using caller DecidableEq instances. The rightFreeScalarExtensionEquiv_toLinearMap_eq_rightExtension law chooses equality decisions internally. Independent index and scalar universes are retained.

main_results.name: Module.rightEndomorphismMatrixEquiv
main_results.note: Column-convention square matrices represent opposite-scalar linear endomorphisms with same-order composition. The square rightEndomorphismScalarExtension specializes rectangular coefficient transport and retains its finite-coordinate Ring tensor bridge.

main_results.name: Module.rightEndomorphism_bijective_of_quotientScalarExtension_bijective
main_results.note: Reflect finite right-module invertibility through a quasiregular two-sided quotient, not arbitrary quotients.

main_results.name: LinearMap.splitKernelProjection
main_results.note: For Semiring R, AddCommGroup M and AddCommMonoid A with R-module structures, R-linear maps i : A → M and r : M → A with r.comp i = id give a projection M → ker r. Its underlying value is x - i (r x). Scalar and both carrier universes are independent; no finiteness, projectivity, freeness, Noetherian, commutativity or Small premise. The projection follows Formal Frontier's formalization and uses Mathlib's linear-map and kernel APIs.

main_results.name: LinearMap.splitKernelProjection_apply
main_results.note: The coerced projection value is x - i (r x), over any semiring with additive-commutative-group source M and additive-commutative-monoid target A, R-linear i : A → M, r : M → A and r.comp i = id. No finite or projective premise; all three universes are independent.

main_results.name: LinearMap.splitKernelProjection_comp_subtype
main_results.note: The projection composed with (ker r).subtype is the identity on ker r. Only Semiring R, AddCommGroup M, AddCommMonoid A, their R-module structures and R-linear i : A → M, r : M → A with r.comp i = id are required, with independent scalar and carrier universes.

main_results.name: LinearMap.finite_splitKernel
main_results.note: For Semiring R, AddCommGroup M and AddCommMonoid A with R-module structures, R-linear i : A → M, r : M → A and r.comp i = id, Module.Finite R M gives Module.Finite R (ker r). Source projectivity is not required, nor target finiteness or projectivity, freeness, Noetherian or commutative scalars, or Small. All three universes are independent. The proof uses the projection retraction and Mathlib's Module.Finite.of_surjective.

main_results.name: LinearMap.projective_splitKernel
main_results.note: For Semiring R, AddCommGroup M and AddCommMonoid A with R-module structures, R-linear i : A → M, r : M → A and r.comp i = id, Module.Projective R M gives Module.Projective R (ker r). No source finiteness or target finiteness/projectivity is required, nor freeness, Noetherian or commutative scalars, or Small. All three universes are independent. The proof reuses Mathlib's Module.Projective.of_split with the kernel inclusion and projection.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.pi
main_results.note: Supporting projectivity instance for finite dependent products over any semiring, with canonical pointwise module structure and independent scalar, index and carrier universes. Only projectivity of the factors is required, not finite generation, freeness or additive inverses. The proof transports Mathlib's dependent finitely supported projectivity along its finite-index linear equivalence.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.exists_fin_generating_family_iff_exists_prod_equiv
main_results.note: Explicit n-generator/projective-complement equivalence, including the zero-generator case.

main_results.name: Module.Basis.exists_hasMinimalSupport
main_results.note: Minimal support relative to a supplied fixed-index basis.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.free_of_isUnit_compl
main_results.note: Finite projective right modules are free given a proper two-sided ideal whose complement consists of units. The ring hypotheses exclude the zero ring; the zero module and zero rank remain allowed.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.exists_fin_rightFree_split_containing
main_results.note: Under the same proper-ideal/unit-complement hypotheses, contain an element in a finite right-free split summand.

main_results.name: Module.CountablyGenerated
main_results.note: Sequence-spanning countable generation, including padded finite families and countable supported free modules.

main_results.name: Module.CountablyGenerated.submodule_of_isNoetherianRing
main_results.note: Every submodule of a sequence-spanned module over a possibly noncommutative left-Noetherian ring is countably generated; no ambient Noetherian, free or projective module assumption.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.exists_fin_rightFree_biorthogonal_exhaustion_of_countablyGenerated
main_results.note: Countable finite-free biorthogonal exhaustion for projectives under proper-ideal/unit-complement hypotheses.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.exists_sigma_fin_rightBasis_of_countablyGenerated
main_results.note: Assemble that exhaustion into a basis indexed by a sigma of finite blocks, allowing rank-zero blocks.

main_results.name: LinearMap.exists_countable_invariant_supported
main_results.note: Countable invariant supported closure for an endomorphism of a standard free module; no idempotence assumption.

main_results.name: LinearMap.exists_countable_invariant_coordinate_filtration
main_results.note: Well-ordered exhaustive invariant coordinate filtration with countable increments; ambient basis need not be countable.

main_results.name: LinearMap.supportedRangeProdComplementEquiv
main_results.note: Split nested invariant supported ranges of an idempotent; complementary increments are projective.

main_results.name: LinearMap.supportedRangeComplement_countablyGenerated
main_results.note: Countable coordinate differences give countably generated complements with the stated invariance and idempotence.

main_results.name: LinearMap.CountableInvariantCoordinateFiltration.range_free_of_free_increments
main_results.note: An idempotent range is free when its filtration increments are free; not an unconditional free-range claim.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.free_of_isUnit_compl_arbitraryRank
main_results.note: Arbitrary-rank projective right-module freeness under the proper-ideal/unit-complement hypotheses.

main_results.name: Module.Projective.free_of_pid
main_results.note: Every projective over a commutative PID is free, using arbitrary-rank free-submodule freeness.

main_results.name: LaurentPolynomial.module_free_of_finite_projective
main_results.note: Finite projectives over one-variable Laurent polynomials over a field are free, with a separate opposite-ring endpoint.

main_results.name: IsIdempotentElem.free_span_iff
main_results.note: For a commutative semiring R and idempotent e, Module.Free R (Ideal.span {e}) iff e = 0 or e = 1. Includes the zero and unit ideals and the zero semiring; no nontriviality, domain or local hypothesis is required.

main_results.name: IsIdempotentElem.not_free_span
main_results.note: For a commutative semiring and idempotent e with e ≠ 0 and e ≠ 1, the principal ideal Ideal.span {e} is not free. Nontriviality of the ideal is derived from its nonzero generator, not assumed.

main_results.name: IsIdempotentElem.smul_span
main_results.note: Over a commutative semiring, an idempotent e acts identically on its principal ideal: e • x = x for every x : Ideal.span {e}.

main_results.name: IsIdempotentElem.one_sub_smul_span
main_results.note: Over a commutative ring, the complementary idempotent annihilates the principal ideal: (1 - e) • x = 0 for every x : Ideal.span {e}, assuming IsIdempotentElem e.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.rankAtStalk_ofLocallyConstantRank
main_results.note: Every locally constant natural-valued prime-spectrum function is realized by a finite projective over a commutative ring.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.FiniteProjective.prodComplementEquiv
main_results.note: Explicit finite-standard-free complement of the threshold-idempotent realization.

main_results.name: Module.rankFiberRingEquiv
main_results.note: Decompose the commutative base ring along a finite projective's nonempty rank fibers.

main_results.name: Module.rankFiberLinearEquiv
main_results.note: Reconstruct the finite projective from rank-fiber base changes, including the empty-spectrum zero ring.

main_results.name: Module.ComponentwiseFree.nonempty_linearEquiv_of_rankAtStalk_eq
main_results.note: Componentwise-free modules in independent universes with equal stalk ranks are linearly equivalent.

main_results.name: ModuleCat.componentwiseFreeSkeletonEquiv
main_results.note: Locally constant ranks classify the skeleton of componentwise-free finite projectives, not all finite projectives.

main_results.name: Module.End.subsingleton_of_linearEquiv_prod
main_results.note: Over a semiring, a Dedekind-finite endomorphism monoid of M forces P to be subsingleton whenever M is linearly equivalent to M × P. Neither finite generation nor freeness is needed; scalar, M and P universes are independent.

main_results.name: RankCondition.card_le_of_linearEquiv_prod
main_results.note: Over a semiring with the rank condition, finite bases of M and N give the target basis cardinality at most the source basis cardinality if M is linearly equivalent to N × P for any semimodule P. Scalar, module, complement and basis-index universes are independent.

main_results.name: IsStablyFiniteRing.subsingleton_of_linearEquiv_prod
main_results.note: A finite-free semimodule over a stably finite semiring cancels from an equivalence with itself times any complementary semimodule; scalar, module and complement universes are independent.

main_results.name: IsStablyFiniteRing.subsingleton_of_finite_projective_linearEquiv_prod
main_results.note: A finite projective module over a stably finite ring cancels from an equivalence with itself times any complementary module, with independent scalar, module and complement universes.

main_results.name: rankCondition_iff_le_of_fin_linearEquiv_fin_prod
main_results.note: For a ring, the rank condition is equivalent to n ≤ m whenever a finite coordinate module of size m is linearly equivalent to one of size n times a complementary module in the ring's universe. The converse does not assert splitting for arbitrary semirings.

main_results.name: isStablyFiniteRing_iff_subsingleton_of_fin_linearEquiv_fin_prod
main_results.note: For a ring, stable finiteness is equivalent to every equivalence from the finite coordinate module of size n to itself times P forcing P to be subsingleton, for complements P in the ring's universe. No arbitrary-semiring converse is claimed.

main_results.name: LinearMap.traceOfFiniteProjective_comp_comm
main_results.note: The traces of g.comp f and f.comp g agree for maps between two finite projective additive-commutative-monoid modules over a commutative semiring, with independent scalar and carrier universes.

main_results.name: LinearMap.traceOfFiniteProjective_tensorProduct
main_results.note: Applying the contraction trace after the bilinear tensor-product map equals multiplying the two factor traces for finite projective additive-commutative-monoid modules over a commutative semiring, with independent scalar and factor universes.

main_results.name: LinearMap.traceOfFiniteProjective_tensorProduct'
main_results.note: The contraction trace of TensorProduct.map f g is the product of the factor traces, for endomorphisms of finite projective additive-commutative-monoid modules over a commutative semiring.

main_results.name: LinearMap.traceOfFiniteProjective_pi
main_results.note: The contraction trace of an arbitrary endomorphism of a finite dependent product is the finsum of the traces of its diagonal projection-endomorphism-single composites. The factors are finite projective additive-commutative-monoid modules over a commutative semiring. Only root index finiteness is assumed; scalar, index and carrier universes are independent, without an enumeration, basis, additive inverses or an additional output-projectivity premise.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.conjugationCoeff
main_results.note: Over any ring and finite index type, the coefficient is (sum i, b i * a i) + (1 - sum i, b i) * (1 - sum i, a i). No orthogonality or ideal hypothesis is needed for its definition. It intertwines corresponding members of two orthogonal families; it reduces to the diagonal sum when a sums to one, to the two-idempotent expression for a singleton, and to one for an empty index.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.conjugatingUnit
main_results.note: For an orthogonal family a, a two-sided ideal I contained in the Jacobson radical, and b i - a i in I for every i, construct a unit whose value is conjugationCoeff a b. The value is congruent to one modulo I. Orthogonality of b is not needed for this construction.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.conjugatingUnit_mul_inv
main_results.note: If b is also orthogonal, this one unit simultaneously conjugates every a i to b i. Neither family must sum to one. Noncommutative and zero rings and empty indices are allowed; the empty-family unit is one. Scalar and index universes are independent.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.exists_conjugatingUnit_of_ker_le_jacobson
main_results.note: Given any ring homomorphism whose kernel lies in the source Jacobson radical, two equal-image finite orthogonal families are conjugate by a unit with the specified coefficient as its value, mapping to one and congruent to one modulo the kernel. No surjectivity is required; source, target and index universes are independent.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.exists_conjugatingUnit_of_isNilpotent_ker
main_results.note: The same equal-image conjugacy conclusion holds when every element of the whole kernel is nilpotent. No common nilpotence exponent, surjectivity, completeness of the families, commutativity or nontriviality assumption is imposed.

main_results.name: RingHom.map_conjugationCoeff
main_results.note: Any unital f : R →+* S sends conjugationCoeff a b to conjugationCoeff (f ∘ a) (f ∘ b), for arbitrary finite families a b : ι → R. No orthogonality, ideals or congruences are required. This is a simp law over possibly noncommutative or zero rings, with empty indices allowed and independent scalar and index universes.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.map_conjugatingUnit
main_results.note: For an orthogonal finite family a and any unital f : R →+* S, Units.map f.toMonoidHom of the source constructed unit equals the target constructed unit in Sˣ. The source uses a two-sided ideal I ≤ Ring.jacobson R and b i - a i ∈ I for every i; the target uses its own two-sided ideal J ≤ Ring.jacobson S and f (b i) - f (a i) ∈ J for every i. Orthogonality of the image of a is derived by OrthogonalIdempotents.map, not an extra hypothesis. No ideal-image containment, radical preservation, injectivity or surjectivity is assumed. The target data name the target construction; they are not needed merely to map a source unit. The family b need not be idempotent or orthogonal, so this is construction transport, not simultaneous conjugacy in that generality. Neither family must sum to one; noncommutative and zero rings, empty indices and independent scalar and index universes are allowed. This is not a simp law, since the target ideal data occur only on the right.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.conjugationCoeff_comp_equiv
main_results.note: For arbitrary finite families a b : ι → R and any e : κ ≃ ι, conjugationCoeff (a ∘ e) (b ∘ e) = conjugationCoeff a b. Both families are reindexed together. This simp law requires no orthogonality, ideal or congruence data, over possibly noncommutative or zero rings, with empty indices and independent ring and both index universes allowed.

main_results.name: OrthogonalIdempotents.conjugatingUnit_comp_equiv
main_results.note: For an orthogonal finite family a, a two-sided ideal I ≤ Ring.jacobson R, b i - a i ∈ I for every i, and any e : κ ≃ ι, jointly reindexing a and b leaves the constructed unit unchanged in Rˣ. The reindexed construction uses the same ideal and the congruence at e k; orthogonality is transported by OrthogonalIdempotents.equiv. No idempotence or orthogonality of b, sum-to-one, commutativity or nontriviality hypothesis is required. Empty finite indices and independent ring and both index universes are included. This is a construction identity, not simultaneous conjugacy for arbitrary b.
